full_judgment: Sultan Hossain Khan J.- This rule has been referred to this Bench by the learned Chief Justice for a decision since contrary views with regard to the question whether an application for pre-emption under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act 1950 (hereinafter referred to as the Act) would fail in absence of a finding by the trial Court as to the eligibility of a pre-emptor u/s 90 of the Act to pre-empt a transfer have been expressed by some Single Benches of this Court.
